# Family Transitions, Inc.

> Family Transitions, Inc. is a behavioral health and developmental disability services organization in Central Virginia, founded in 2003. It serves children, teens, adults and families in Richmond, North Chesterfield, Chesterfield County, Petersburg and surrounding communities. Main phone: (804) 745-5101.

Key facts:
- Founded in 2003 as an intensive in-home services agency; now offers five programs.
- Programs are licensed by the Virginia Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Services (DBHDS).
- DD Day Support accepts the DD Waiver, Day Support Waiver services and private pay.
- Outpatient therapy is provided with sister organization Core Behavioral Health, LLC.
- Anyone can make a referral, including families, schools, doctors, case managers, social workers and probation officers.
- In a crisis, call or text 988. In an emergency, call 911.

## Services
- [Outpatient Therapy](https://familytransitionsinc.com/services/outpatient-therapy/): Individual, couples and family therapy for children, teens and adults in Central Virginia, provided with our sister practice Core Behavioral Health.
- [Intensive In-Home Services](https://familytransitionsinc.com/services/intensive-in-home/): Home-based, family-focused counseling for children and young people ages 5 to 21 with emotional or behavioral challenges in Central Virginia.
- [Adult Mental Health Skill Building](https://familytransitionsinc.com/services/mental-health-skill-building/): Individualized life-skills training and support in the home and community for adults 18 and older living with serious mental illness in Central Virginia.
- [DD Day Support Services](https://familytransitionsinc.com/services/dd-day-support/): Center-based day support in Petersburg, VA for adults 18+ with developmental disabilities: daily living skills, community outings and recreation. DD Waiver accepted.
- [Sponsored Residential Services](https://familytransitionsinc.com/services/sponsored-residential/): Family-style homes for adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities in Central Virginia, with personalized care, 24/7 support and community involvement.

## Locations
- [Administrative Office & Outpatient Therapy, North Chesterfield](https://familytransitionsinc.com/locations/north-chesterfield/): 620 Moorefield Park Drive, Suite 218, North Chesterfield, VA 23236. Phone (804) 745-5101. Hours: Mon–Thu 9 AM–5 PM, Fri 9 AM–4 PM.
- [DD Day Support Center, Petersburg](https://familytransitionsinc.com/locations/petersburg/): 111 Morton Avenue, Petersburg, VA 23805. Phone (804) 733-3922. Hours: Mon–Fri 8:30 AM–3:30 PM.

## Get help
- [Make a referral](https://familytransitionsinc.com/referrals/): Refer yourself, a family member or a client.
- [Become a sponsored residential provider](https://familytransitionsinc.com/become-a-provider/): Open your home to an adult with ID/DD.
- [Who we help](https://familytransitionsinc.com/who-we-help/): Find the right program by age and need.
- [Careers](https://familytransitionsinc.com/careers/): Openings for DSPs, QIDPs, QMHP-A and QMHP-C counselors and clinical supervisors.

## Resources
- [Intensive In-Home Services in Richmond, VA](https://familytransitionsinc.com/resources/intensive-in-home-services-richmond-va/): How Intensive In-Home Services help children and young adults ages 5 to 21 and their families in Richmond, North Chesterfield and Petersburg, VA.
- [What Is Sponsored Residential?](https://familytransitionsinc.com/resources/what-is-sponsored-residential/): How sponsored residential services give adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities a family-like home, personalized support and a place in the community.
